verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs list 'Offer payment links' as a capability and describe a Customer Area for managing the account. The MCP server exposes payment-link create/get/expire tools, but that is an API/agent path, not no-code dashboard creation. Community reports of Adyen turning away small clients and imposing minimum volumes cast doubt on a founder being able to 'start selling immediately', though they do not concretely contradict the payment-link feature itself. Missing for 10: documented no-code payment-link creation in the Customer Area dashboard, evidence of shareable link configuration, evidence that a new founder can go live immediately, independent hands-on corroboration.
